name: Heroka's Saga, Vol. I
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 15
Price 20,000 gp; Accuracy -1
Category Dungeon Guides
Associated Skill Perform (oratory) (DC 15)
Description
The first volume in a long series of wild tales about an adventurer-warrior named Heroka takes place in the shattered city of Kho in the Mwangi Expanse.
Skill Bonuses
Understand Uomoto practices and traditions (Knowledge [local] +4)
Identify poisonous flora (Knowledge [nature] +2)
